correctness.rationale: The four-cell rule gives an output 11 iff the incoming 11 from the right is not met by a 00 from the left, and likewise for 00. Alternation between marked bonds imposes odd distances for like signs and even distances for opposite signs. The words in question are exactly neighboring +,− pairs separated by 2k+2 bonds. For an output +,− pair at distance d, its input ancestors are at distance d−2, and the intervening list, even if it includes annihilated particles, contains a neighboring +,− pair. Conversely shift the desired output marks back by one step: +,− distances shrink by two but remain positive; −,+ distances grow, and same-sign distances are unchanged. Parity reconstructs an input with the required gap bound and without a collision. The no-mark case is the exchange of the two alternating configurations. This proves the bilateral image equality by induction. No forbidden word contains another; the period 11(01)^t00 proves strict inclusion. Any finite avoiding word extends bilaterally by zeros to the left and ones to the right. No forbidden word can overlap another: proper suffixes of length ≥2 do not start with 11, and the one-symbol suffix is 0 rather than 1. Each rejected one-symbol extension therefore corresponds to exactly one forbidden suffix and an arbitrary avoiding prefix. This gives the recurrence and rational series. Its first positive pole is the unique z in (0,1/φ) with 1−z−z²=z^(t+2), and nonnegative coefficients identify that pole with the radius. The equation (λ−φ)(λ+φ^(−1))=λ^(−t) bounds λ−φ by φ^(−t)/√5, so (λ/φ)^t tends to 1, yielding the stated entropy constant after taking logarithms. The no-11 shift gives the lower bound at infinite time, with the finite-time entropies giving the matching upper bound. The t=0 case gives the full shift and λ=2. Inspected the finite checker and its recorded scope without executing it; the all-time argument, not bounded ring tests, proves the claim.
